title: 预约与到店记录
Reservations and visits
no_reward: 管理员代建或补录不赠送预约积分，之后编辑或完成也不赠送。
Host-created reservations and past visits do not earn booking points, including after edits or completion.
backfill_help: 仅补录已经结束的真实到店。保存后生成待填写金额的经营记录，不自动扣钱包时长。
Record a visit that has already ended. Saving creates a business record awaiting its amount; wallet time is not deducted automatically.
booking_help: 按当前营业时间和余位添加，日期与时间均为汉密尔顿当地时间。
Use current opening hours and availability. Dates and times are local to Hamilton.
saved: 记录已保存，未赠送预约积分。
empty: 这位顾客还没有预约或到店记录。
This guest has no reservations or visits yet.
uncertain: 保存结果暂未确认。请重试同一请求，避免重复添加。
The save result is not confirmed. Retry the same request to avoid a duplicate.
unavailable: 该时间段当前不可预约，请调整日期、时间或人数。
This time is unavailable. Adjust the date, time or guest count.
reservation_backfill_not_finished: 请填写已结束的到店时间，结束时间须晚于开始时间。
Enter a visit that has ended, with its end after its start.
interval_invalid: 请填写有效的开始和结束时间。
Enter valid start and end times.
